audience: rental, holiday park and accommodation operators who manage bookings in Bookster

useCases.title: Review arrivals and unpaid bookings for a period
useCases.text: List the bookings for an arrival or departure period, filtered by state. Open one booking to see its party, value and balance.

useCases.title: Quote the availability and stay prices of a property
useCases.text: Read the availability ranges of a property. Read its length-of-stay prices to find the cheapest stay for a party size.

useCases.title: Tag bookings that are handled outside Bookster
useCases.text: Set your own CamelCase tags on a booking, for example after it is handled in another system. The booking record in Bookster changes.

useCases.title: Answer guest questions about a property
useCases.text: Open a property to read its address, facilities and descriptions. Use them to answer guest questions before a booking.

useCases.title: Check whether online booking is open
useCases.text: Check whether online booking is enabled, disabled or sold out for a property. Read its rates or extras document to explain a price.
